_comment: Atomic mathematical statements with status. status ∈ {proven, open, refuted}. kind ∈ {equivalence, theorem, conjecture, bound, counterexample}. doc = associated document. This layer lets the assistant NEVER present a refuted statement as true.

claims.statement: All non-trivial zeros of ζ(s) have Re(s)=1/2.
The RH analogue for curves over finite fields (|α_i|=q^{1/2}) is true.
RH ⟺ π(x)=Li(x)+O(√x·log x).
RH ⟺ M(x)=O(x^{1/2+ε}) for every ε>0.
|M(x)| < √x for all x (Mertens conjecture, STRONGER than RH).
RH ⟺ σ(n) < e^γ·n·log log n for all n>5040.
RH ⟺ λ_n ≥ 0 for all n≥1 (Li coefficients).
RH ⟺ Weil functional W(g⋆ḡ) ≥ 0 for all test functions g.
RH ⟺ χ_{(0,1]} lies in the L² closure of the dilations of {1/x} (Báez-Duarte: integer).
RH ⟺ ξ ∈ Laguerre–Pólya class ⟺ all Jensen polynomials hyperbolic.
RH ⟺ Λ ≤ 0 (de-Bruijn–Newman constant).
Λ ≥ 0 (the RH is, if true, only barely true).
RH ⟺ the inverse spectral problem for fractal strings holds for all D∈(0,1)\{1/2}.
RH ⟺ det(R_n)=O(n^{1/2+ε}), where det(R_n)=M(n).
Infinitely many zeros lie on the critical line.
More than 41% of all non-trivial zeros lie on the critical line.
Pair correlation of the zeros = GUE kernel 1−(sin πu/πu)² (under RH, |α|≤1).
N(3/4,T) ≪ T^{13/25+o(1)} (improvement of Ingham's 3/5).
L(1,χ) ≫ (log D)^{-2022}, effectively (Landau-Siegel zeros constrained).
The Davenport–Heilbronn function (ζ-like, WITHOUT an Euler product) has zeros off Re=1/2.
Epstein zeta with class number>1 has infinitely many zeros with Re>1/2.
Degree-1 elements of the Selberg class (with Euler product+Ramanujan) are exactly ζ and shifted Dirichlet L-functions.
ζ universally approximates every zero-free holomorphic function (Voronin universality).
de Branges' positivity condition implies RH and holds for ζ.
Atiyah's Todd-function proof (2018) is valid.
The first >10^13 zeros all lie on the critical line.
The RH analogue for the Selberg zeta function is true (self-adjoint Laplacian).
RH ⟹ Lindelöf hypothesis ζ(1/2+it)=O(t^ε); reverse direction unknown.
